actions.action: Merge paragraph versions instead of complete documents
actions.mechanism: A causal multi-value register preserves concurrent paragraph edits, including their original text and authorship.
actions.implementation: Persist operations locally with paragraph ID, device/counter ID, two-device causal vector, and text. Exchange missing operations through existing synchronization; retain concurrent versions.
actions.check: Edit different paragraphs offline, then the same paragraph. Both reconnect orders must preserve independent changes and identical conflicting texts with author labels.
actions.risk: Logical revision ordering alone cannot distinguish concurrency; persist causal counters reliably.

actions.action: Synchronize paragraph ordering separately from paragraph text
actions.mechanism: Stable position keys separate moves from prose edits; deterministic tie-breaking handles simultaneous moves.
actions.implementation: Store moves as causal operations containing paragraph ID and a position key between neighbors. Select concurrent move winners by operation ID; sort ties by paragraph ID.
actions.check: Replay simultaneous moves and text edits in reversed delivery orders. Assert identical paragraph order, one occurrence per paragraph, and unchanged retained text versions.
actions.risk: Concurrent placement intent may lose; position keys can grow.

actions.action: Keep deletion conflicts until explicit user resolution
actions.mechanism: Tombstones make deletion an attributable competing version, rather than erasing a concurrent edit.
actions.implementation: Retain deleted text and conflicting edits. Show author/device labels and deletion status; record resolutions referencing all displayed version IDs. An unseen concurrent version remains unresolved.
actions.check: Delete a paragraph offline on one device and edit it on the other. Both reconnect orders must show deletion versus intact edited text.
actions.risk: Premature tombstone cleanup can resurrect paragraphs; avoid time-only expiration.

actions.action: Add deterministic offline replay regression tests
actions.mechanism: A seeded operation-log harness checks convergence and preservation independently of arrival order.
actions.implementation: From a shared baseline, script independent edits, competing edits, moves, deletion versus edit, and resolution. Replay both reconnect orders with duplicates, delayed operations, and restart boundaries.
actions.check: Assert equal canonical states, retained unresolved source texts and authors, and no lost independent edits. Repeat at 500 paragraphs with 8 KB text.
actions.risk: Finite replay cases cannot prove correctness; retain failing seeds as regressions.
